per_candidate.id: s2:High-energy counterpart for fast radio bursts

rationale: Paper 1904.09762 confirms the SFXT nature of AX J1949.8+2534 and reports on its rapid X-ray variability, which is relevant to understanding the dynamic range of X-ray luminosities in SFXTs. However, it does not provide a resolution to the question of the physical mechanisms behind this variability.
